scope: Matched short simulation using the seeded default play configuration, one environment and seed, six continuous 3-second commands; not maximum capability or hardware validation.
actuation_difference: Course training has no absolute position-target clipping. Deployed C++ clips default + scale * action to joint limits while preserving raw last_action. Opt-in simulator clipping now reproduces that order.
trace_naming_note: The old applied_target_joint_pos field in these frozen traces is the actuator INPUT target, before internal deterministic actuator latency. It is renamed actuator_input_target_joint_pos in newer runs. The clipping metrics are unaffected.
observations: All four short rollouts had zero terminations or timeouts.

Tej VelocityFS initial stand in legacy simulation saturated leg_back_l_2 at +3Nm throughout the scored interval, with mean position +0.451rad against nominal upper limit +0.420rad. With deployment clipping its initial standing peak torque fell to 1.053Nm.

StableGait lateral XY error increased from 0.0509 to 0.0694m/s with deployment clipping. VelocityFS increased from 0.0330 to 0.0702m/s; the unclipped lateral advantage did not survive this matched deployment condition.
Network export parity is distinct from actuation parity: both recovered exports numerically match their checkpoints, while unbounded simulated targets can still differ from deployed commands.

recommendation.next_experiment: Finetune StableGait with the explicit deployment target clamp, preserving its original eight reward weights, then compare the original and finetuned checkpoints under that same clamp across held-out seeds/command sequences/dynamics.
recommendation.default_promotion: Do not automatically replace StableGait with VelocityFS from the short default-play velocity metrics. Retain both artifacts and comparisons.

default_play_randomization_note: The provided locomotion play=True configuration retains startup friction, encoder-bias, PD-gain and inertial randomization plus actor observation noise. These are seeded default-play tests, not an unperturbed nominal model. The same task and seed are paired; realized randomization values were not saved in these older rollouts.
